standard_prerequisites.name: The definition of quasi-compactness for a space and for a map, and the notion of a retrocompact subset
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Set up in the author's sections on quasi-compact spaces and maps, immediately before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the two hypotheses and the two conclusions.

core_obligations: Part (1): pulling back an open covering of the image gives an open covering of the source, and quasi-compactness of the source yields a finite subcovering whose images give a finite subcovering of the image (proof lines 1973-1977).

Part (2): for a quasi-compact map the author checks the defining property of retrocompactness for the image, namely that its intersection with a quasi-compact open is quasi-compact (proof lines 1977-1981).
Conclusion: the two numbered assertions (proof line 1981).
proof_roadmap: (1) 把像的开覆盖拉回成源的开覆盖，用源的准紧性取有限子覆盖，其像给出像的有限子覆盖。
(2) 对 diffusion 型的准紧映射直接验证 retrocompact 的定义：像与任意准紧开集之交准紧。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the two image properties of quasi-compact spaces and maps (author lemma at source lines 1963-1970, label lemma-image-quasi-compact): a continuous image of a quasi-compact space is quasi-compact, and the image of a quasi-compact map is retrocompact. The proof (source lines 1972-1982) proves the first part by pulling back coverings (proof lines 1973-1977) and verifies retrocompactness directly for the second (proof lines 1977-1981). Together with the corresponding statements for Noetherian and constructible sets these are the basic image properties used throughout the chapter. H2.
